description: Structured Pydantic schema for TAMSAMSOMEstimator agent output.

tam_description.description: Detailed description of Total Addressable Market (TAM).
tam_description.title: Tam Description

tam_value.description: Estimated monetary value of TAM (e.g. '$45.2 Billion').
tam_value.title: Tam Value

sam_description.description: Detailed description of Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM).
sam_description.title: Sam Description

sam_value.description: Estimated monetary value of SAM (e.g. '$6.8 Billion').
sam_value.title: Sam Value

som_description.description: Detailed description of Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM).
som_description.title: Som Description

som_value.description: Estimated monetary value of SOM (e.g. '$120 Million').
som_value.title: Som Value

methodology.description: Methodology and assumptions used for market sizing calculation.
methodology.title: Methodology

confidence_score.description: Confidence score rating strictly between 0.0 and 1.0.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

citations.description: Source URLs backing the claims above, when external research (Tavily/Exa/Zyte) was supplied in the prompt. Optional and defaults empty so this schema stays backward compatible with LLM-only reasoning when no research bundle is available.
citations.title: Citations

title: TAMSAMSOMAnalysis
